dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Hello, see anything you like? If you can't find the right one, I can have one custom-made for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to get some souvenirs.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Be my guest. Just let me know when you see something that you like.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your store...

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: You mean where the name of this store came from?

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Haha, I see you're not from Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Netsuke is a kind of small craftwork that the Inazumans carry with them as pendants. Generally, they are carved into different shapes based on the owner's preference.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Take this one for instance. If you cross the rope from the inner side of the belt and then hang a coin pouch, seal or stamp on it, the netsuke will be stuck onto the belt. Convenient, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: As for the "Gen" part of the name... Well, it's my name, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What can you make to order?

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: What would you like? Just tell me, and I will do my best to make it happen.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: This store may not be as famous as those old family stores on this street, but we are still proud of our fine craftsmanship.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: To be honest, I'm actually the eldest son of my family, but people always say that I am simple and dull, and that I probably won't be able to carry on with the family business.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Haha, that's why I would rather start a small store here and help the neighbors out with my handiwork.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you! Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Goodbye! Come back next time if you need anything.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to buy a few things...

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Let me see what you need, dear customer...

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Ah, my sincere apologies, but we are still in the midst of arranging for the goods that you require.

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Our capacities are limited, and it will take some time for the goods to be restocked, so please do come again then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: Haha, impressive. I didn't expect you to be so adaptable...

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: It looks like you missed a few details...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any special goods here?

dialogues.speaker: Mikoshi Genichirou
dialogues.text: I do have some consignments that I was given. Will they be to your liking, I wonder?
